abstract.p: A process in which a recovered phenol compound obtained in polycarbonate production with a specific polycondensation catalyst is subjected as a starting material to transesterification and decarbonylation to produce a diaryl carbonate while avoiding various problems caused by impurities, and the diaryl carbonate is subjected to polycondensation to thereby industrially advantageously produce a polycarbonate. The process comprises: a first step in which a diaryl oxalate is synthesized by the transesterification of a dialkyl oxalate with a phenol compound; a second step in which a diaryl carbonate is obtained by the decarbonylation of the diaryl oxalate; a third step in which a polycarbonate is produced by the polycondensation of the diaryl carbonate with a polyhydroxy compound; and a fourth step in which the phenol compound yielded as a by-product in the polycondensation system is separated therefrom and the recovered phenol compound is purified to obtain a purified phenol compound in which the content of the impurities derived from the polycondensation has been reduced. The resultant purified phenol compound is circulated for use in the transesterification as the first step.

L'invention porte sur une procédé avantageux d'obtention de polycarbonate, exempt de problèmes liés aux impuretés, à l'aide d'un catalyseur spécifique de polycondensation, consistant à soumettre un précurseur à des réactions de transestérification et de décarbonylation, ce qui donnera un diarylcarbonate, qui soumis à la polycondensation donnera à son tour un polycarbonate. Le procédé comporte les étapes suivantes: (1) synthèse de diaryloxalate par transestérification de dialkyloxalate à l'aide d'un composé phénolique; (2) obtention de diarylcarbonate par décarbonylation du diaryloxalate; (3) obtention du polycarbonate par polycondensation du avec un composé polyhydroxy; (4) séparation du composé phénolique obtenu comme sous produit dans le processus de polycondensation et purification dudit composé où les impuretés provenant de la polycondensation sont fortement réduites. Le composé phénolique purifié est réinjecté dans le processus de transestérification de la phase (1).
